2. This is an application seeking to quash the charge-sheet arising out of First Information Report
No.67 of 2023 registered at Cyber Cell, Sadar Police Station, Nagpur for the offence punishable
under Sections 120-B, 386, 420, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66(D) of the
Information Technology Act, 2000.
3.
In the FIR, it is alleged that co-accused namely Anant @ Sontu Jain instigated the informant to indulge into gaming activities.
He has provided various links and by deceptive means has cheated for huge sum to the extent of Rs.58 crores and therefore, the report.
4. It is the applicant's contention that he has no way concern with the activities in between the informant and co-accused Anant.
It is argued that after arrest, Anant made a statement that the links were procured by him from the applicant and on that basis, the applicant has been arraigned.

It is argued that merely on the basis 2 23.apl.1102.2024 of statement of co-accused, the applicant Rakesh Kumar Prata Rai Rajdev vs The State Of Maharashtra (At The ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21980705/

sentences.text: 5. The informant has appeared in the proceedings through the Counsel and filed an affidavit stating that he has no concerned with the applicant nor he alleges anything against the present applicant.
6. Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable after four weeks.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives notice on behalf of the State.
7. In the meantime, the trial shall be stayed against the present applicant till next date.
